set.body: Acceptance criteria: implement separately identified I2MC-compatible noise-robust fixation detection and REMoDNaV-compatible rich classification for pursuits and post-saccadic oscillations; every implementation card states canonical citation, exact deviations, sampling and coordinate requirements, preprocessing assumptions, stimulus support, streaming status, known failure modes, and benchmark identity; prepared-input validation preserves named failures; sample labels and source support remain complete; designated conformance and annotated benchmark fixtures pass; no detector is selected or substituted silently.
set.title: Validated I2MC and REMoDNaV-compatible detector families
